content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: Nalanda University has announced vacancies for various Non-Teaching Positions including library, administration, engineering and support staff posts. The post-wise vacancy details and pay scale mentioned in the notification are given below.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each position.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification and experience requirements for the respective Non-Teaching post. The eligibility conditions vary according to the position applied for. The qualifications prescribed for these posts must be obtained from a recognised University or Institution of repute.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Qualification
content_sections.text: The post-wise educational qualification and experience requirements are given below.

rows.educational_qualification_experience: Master’s Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade. Minimum 10 years of experience at the level of Assistant Librarian / Deputy Librarian / Additional Librarian in a University, College, Indian or Foreign Research Institution of comparable standards, including at least 3 years at the level of Deputy Librarian / Additional Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including integration of ICT in library. Ph.D. Degree in Library Science / Documentation / Archives and Manuscript Keeping.

Master’s Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade. Eight years of experience as Assistant University Librarian / College Librarian. Evidence of innovative library services including ICT integration in library. Ph.D. Degree in Library Science / Information Science / Documentation Science / Archives and Manuscript Keeping / Computerization of Library.

Master’s Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent along with a good academic record. Minimum 5 years professional experience in a university, educational or research institution; or equivalent technical/research experience with proven administrative capabilities. Experience in administration, admission, examination, establishment, procurement, performance management system, training and development, welfare, legal, campus/estate or materials management/stores.

Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering from a recognised University/Institution. At least 2 years post qualification experience in a government body or commercial establishment of repute as Junior Engineer or similar capacity.

Bachelor’s Degree from a recognised University/Institution. At least 5 years experience in related fields of Administration, Establishment, Academic, Finance & Accounts and General Supervision/Management. Proficiency in Computer Operation, noting and drafting.

Master’s Degree in Library & Information Science from a recognised University/Institution with 2 years experience in the relevant field in University/Research Establishment/Central or State Government/PSU/Autonomous Institutions. OR Bachelor’s Degree in Library / Library and Information Science with 3 years experience in the relevant field. Knowledge of Computer Applications is required.

Bachelor’s Degree from a recognised University/Institution. At least 3 years experience in related fields of Administration, Establishment, Academic, Finance & Accounts and General Supervision/Management. Proficiency in Computer Operation, noting and drafting.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive pay according to the scale mentioned for each Non-Teaching position.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 have to pay an application fee of ₹500 for each position .

rows.fee_details: UTR Number / Transaction Reference Number must be mentioned in the application form

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each position. The University reserves the right to fill or not fill any advertised post. The number of advertised posts may increase or decrease depending on university requirements. Shortlisted candidates must produce original certificates/testimonials and valid photo identity proof during the selection process. Selected candidates will be required to relocate to Rajgir, Nalanda District, Bihar. The selected candidate will have to execute an Employment Contract with Nalanda University.

content_sections.heading: Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026 will be conducted as per the rules and requirements decided by Nalanda University. Candidates will be shortlisted based on the prescribed qualification, experience, suitability and other relevant criteria. The University reserves the right to conduct a written test, skill test, interview or any combination of these selection stages. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for the selection process. Candidates shortlisted for the selection process must produce original certificates, testimonials and valid photo identity proof for verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Nalanda University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the online application link provided by Nalanda University. Select the desired Non-Teaching position. Fill in the required personal, educational and professional details. Upload the required documents and certificates. Pay the application fee of ₹500 for each position through online mode. Enter the UTR Number / Transaction Reference Number in the application form. Submit the application form before 21 August 2026. Keep a copy of the submitted application form and payment details for future reference.
